svg.text: The feed is cut into sections, one per author: every turn's band names its agent and stays on top while its rows scroll under it.

text.tspan: opens the task, files open the Workspace
Make Activity and Handoffs readable, like
Links first, then the bands. Keep

svg.text: The band sticks under the toolbar while its
rows scroll; it carries chip, name, team, role.
Every row in a turn is that agent's work.
A brief: compact Markdown, cut at ~10 lines
on a clean line, no fade. ‘Show all · 38 lines’
Commands wrap at spaces, 3 lines, then
‘Show all’. Monaco colours them only once
they scroll into view; plain mono until then.
Links are underlined, not colour alone. A SHA
of the branch opens it in the Workspace.
Fenced code: same box, language top right.
Rows outside a turn get a band too: ‘you’.
External links open a new tab, with ↗.
Handoffs: the brief’s first heading is the card
title; the whole card stays a link to the turn.
At 390 wide: the rail becomes the time alone (56px) and the band drops the team, keeping chip, name and status;
code boxes scroll sideways only for words longer than the line. Dark theme: same tokens, chips tint at 22%.
